body: FOR THE BUILD OF N-42 (moved here from P2-29 on 17 Nov 2026, when the lead's PR #112 filing the item reached main). DRAWN 17 Nov 2026, REVISED in the fix round of PR #114 after the lead's decisions D1 to D5 (PROPOSED; the advisor may change them). Docs only; nothing built, nothing walked. FRAMES (three cases and S-92). S-95 in screens-first-run-and-settings.html: "dlnote" import-elsewhere (1), import-late and "dllock" import-late (2, shade and lock screen). S-60 in screens-player-together-and-more.html: "import" stalled (3, the page, with the Stop of the built Your imports tile drawn). S-92: "perm" notif-asked-import. DROPPED in this round. D1: the stalled card. The stall is told ONLY by one sentence on the import page, because a card cannot be posted once the app is killed (the 30-minute rule runs only while the process lives) and it would reverse PB-43 cost 3 (silence on the card): cost 3 stands. D4: the failed-import card. The Encore server never writes failed (imports/service.py: running, done, stopped; read, not run), so the card would be a dead branch; PB-43 gap (ii) now says NOT reachable today, draw it if a server ever writes it. NOTE FOR THE BUILD: download_card_jobs.dart has a comment "KNOWN GAP (docs/33 PB-43 (ii)) ... Removal trigger: a frame for it drawn in S-95": reword it (no frame is drawn; the branch is dead until a server writes failed). STRINGS (English; Arabic is in the frames). 1. Running card "Downloading Prog snob" / "Downloading to this phone · 12 of 24" (S-16's own line, bar 75 %) beside the existing "Import stopped" / "Prog snob: 24 songs stay in your library. The rest were not fetched.". Stopped on THIS phone: still no card (an import's Stop is final); a Download's Stop is the N-39 card (D2, D3). 2. The ordinary end-of-import card: "Prog snob" is ready / "214 of 214 songs are in your library now." (the numbers go on from the app-closed card, 150 of 214 at 9:03); no time (GET imports has no finished-at). 3. Page: "No change for 30 minutes. Your server may still be working." inside the import's card under the counts; the 200 percent right-to-left cut-off behind the mini player is fixed. S-92: "Show import progress?" / "While your server saves this playlist, Encore can show one notification with how far it has got. No news or alerts are sent unless you switch them on in Settings." (asked once for the whole app, at the first Download or the first Import). WHAT THE BUILD MUST DO. (1) Post the result card when the import is stopped elsewhere even though its job is merged with a Download. (2) The phone remembers the imports it followed (a small per-account record: id and last state) so an import that stalled, or was running when the app was killed, gets its card at the first look that finds it ended; cleared when posted; older than 24 hours is not announced. (3) The stall sentence on the import page and in S-20's header; the 10 second asking still stops (N-43 removes it). OPEN FOR THE LEAD. a. Case 2 needs persistent storage (a migration or a settings key). b. Left for the build: the CardBar share-retention test. D3 (Stop on a merged line stops only the phone copy) is in the N-39 note.
